commits.subject: Pulse: integer-tick time algebra (rates, timecode DF/NDF labels, rational interchange, tick ranges, trim/ripple lanes)
Pulse: lane scheduling queries, lift/extract/roll/slide, frame snapping, typed timecode parse, STU-VID-012a display enumeration
Pulse: sequence-time edit planners over Folio timeline members (trim, ripple, razor, roll, slip, slide) with link and sync-lock semantics
Pulse: use accord::Ticks Ord/checked_sub (drop wrappers); lift/extract/close-gap and linked razor/roll/slide planners
Pulse: tests for lift/extract/range/close-gap and linked razor/roll/slide/extract; pulse-timeline-consumer example; descriptor update
Pulse: delegate fps_fraction/frame_rate_from_fps/ticks_per_sample/rational seconds/snap_to_frame to accord FrameRate and Timescale (CX-CAP-001); Rounding::Exact stays pulse-local

capabilities_done: timebase_from_import (reuses accord FrameRate::from_import + receipt), frames_to_ticks, ticks_to_frames_exact/floor, fps_fraction, frame_rate_from_fps
timecode label functions: frames_to_timecode, timecode_to_frames, ticks_to_timecode, timecode_to_ticks; NDF + DF (29.97 drop 2, 59.94 drop 4); DF refused on non-NTSC rates; skipped DF labels refused

rational interchange: ticks_from_rational_seconds with Rounding {Exact,Floor,Ceil,NearestHalfUp} + loss flag, rational_seconds_from_ticks, Speed (reduced rational, sign = reverse, exact span/duration)
TickDelta (signed, checked), offset, TickRange [start,end) algebra, Grid {Free, Frames(rate)}
lane ops over ordered Vec<TickRange>: validate_lane, ripple_shift, trim_end, trim_start, ripple_trim_end, ripple_trim_start
report() -> one Observe terminal outcome; DESCRIPTOR; examples/pulse-consumer.rs
scheduling queries over ordered lane: range_at, next_edit_point, prev_edit_point, gaps, close_gap
lift_span / extract_span with LanePiece{origin, range, head_cut, tail_cut} (consumer moves source windows by the cuts); roll_edit; slide
snap_to_frame (Rounding), parse_timecode (':' NDF, ';' DF), TimeDisplay enumeration STU-VID-012a codes 100-112/200/201, time_display_from_import (113 -> frame-rate-matched + warning), format_ticks

plan_timeline_edit(Snapshot, sequence_id, expected_revision, TimelineEdit{TrimOut,TrimIn,Razor,Roll,Slip,Slide}, EditContext{budget,resolver,extents,cancel}) -> EditProposal{changes, read/write footprint, Folio-validated prospective Snapshot at revision+1}; link groups trim/slip together; ripple shifts edited + other sync-locked tracks (sync_lock_blocked/track_locked); video edits whole-frame; SourceExtents typed port (unknown length refuses source-out extension); razor/roll/slide refuse linked clips; zero-effect edit = no_change; Folio validate_document runs on the result (not duplicated)

slice 3: Ticks wrappers dropped (pulse::checked_add/checked_sub removed; accord::Ticks Ord/checked_add/checked_sub used; accord reports underflow as TickOverflow -> pulse overflow); TimelineEdit::{LiftClip, ExtractClip, LiftRange, ExtractRange, CloseGap} over lane lift_span/extract_span/gaps (targeted tracks for range ops, sync-locked tracks ripple, straddled clip takes next caller-supplied fresh id); linked razor (LinkedRazor: right-half ids + new link group), linked roll/slide (allowed when every touched link group is wholly among the touched clips); shift onto a sync-locked video track now requires whole frames; examples/pulse-timeline-consumer.rs (plan_timeline_edit CLI over a built-in Folio sequence, ran: ripple trim 20321280000, extract, razor, overlap refusal exit 2, cancel exit 2)

SMB-ACCORD-ENG-2 migration (6823c34): fps_fraction -> FrameRate::fps_fraction; frame_rate_from_fps -> FrameRate::from_fps; ticks_from_rational_seconds -> Timescale::rational(den,1).ticks_from_units (Rounding::Exact stays pulse-local = Floor + Inexact when !exact); ticks_per_sample -> Timescale::exact_ticks_per_unit; snap_to_frame -> Timescale::rational(fps).units_from_ticks; local gcd/rounding arithmetic removed from time.rs (gcd stays in rational.rs for reduced_speed and rational_seconds_from_ticks). Public pulse API unchanged.
next: rate stretch via SpeedMath; linked range cuts once cut-half link naming is specified; multicam cut-list range algebra; Reel-backed SourceExtents adapter; feet+frames display after verification

notes.scope_note: 2026-10-11 lead decision: pulse owns time only. A first draft of Sequence/Track/Clip/EditProposal planners was written but NEVER committed; moved out of the crate (not in repo; scratchpad copy only) before the first commit. Folio lane (SMB-FOLIO-ENG-1) owns sequence/track/clip document types and consumes pulse time types.
accord_requests: accord::FrameRate exposes only ticks_per_frame(); pulse adds fps_fraction/frame_rate_from_fps externally (optional later accord change)
accord::Ticks::checked_sub reports underflow as TickOverflow (no distinct underflow code); pulse offset()/TickDelta keep distinct underflow

oracle_values.mt_35540_25fps: 2*10160640000 = 20321280000 trimmed duration and ripple start (hardcoded literals)

open_interpretations: UNVERIFIED: a timecode display counts frames of its own rate over real time (a 25 fps sequence showing 24 fps timecode); no Adobe oracle yet
UNVERIFIED: code 113 fallback for 29.97/59.94 picks the non-drop member; feet+frames displays (111/112) return timecode_unsupported until frames-per-foot is verified
notes.speed_convergence: 2026-10-11: pulse::Speed removed; one owner = folio::Speed (document type). Pulse keeps reduced_speed(num,den) and SpeedMath (span_for_duration/duration_for_span) as functions/extension trait over folio::Speed.
notes.dependency_change: Cargo.toml: added hsk-studio-folio (path, =0.1.0, default-features=false); allowed by root workspace.metadata.studio.dependencies.hsk-studio-pulse. Cargo.lock not staged.
known_limits: SourceExtents has no default provider (UnknownExtents refuses source-out extension); Reel/host must supply lengths
fresh clip ids and link group names are caller-supplied (pulse mints no ids)
multicam, transitions, nesting, rate stretch, markers/snapping not started

supported: trim/slip/lift/extract: whole link group, one clip per track
razor: every member split at the same tick; needs LinkedRazor ids else insufficient_ids; right halves get the new link group
roll/slide: every member track, same delta, only when every link group touched (anchor group and neighbour groups) is wholly inside the touched clips
still_refused_linked_edit_unsupported: two members of one link group on the same track
roll/slide whose touched clips have a link-group partner outside the edit (not closed)
LiftRange/ExtractRange overlapping any linked clip (a cut would split or orphan a link group; semantics for group naming of cut halves not specified)

tests_detail_before_migration.clippy_tests_examples: PASS (no findings in pulse; 2 pre-existing too_many_arguments warnings in observe)

accord_migration.pulse_tests: 13 passed (foundation_contract 5, schedule_and_display 2, timeline_edit 6) with unchanged expected values; folio 24 passed (appearance 4, foundation 15, timeline 5); clippy clean for pulse; rustfmt clean
accord_migration.deviation: ticks_from_rational_seconds with Rounding::Exact and a value that is BOTH inexact and above the u64 tick range now reports overflow (accord checks range first) instead of inexact; both are refusals of the same input, no test covers it.
accord_migration.accord_requests_resolved: accord::FrameRate::fps_fraction / from_fps now exist (accord fa0e4b9); the earlier pulse-side fps_fraction/frame_rate_from_fps request is closed
